subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Limited Editions and Exclusivity
description: Learn Limited Editions and Exclusivity in one minute.

hook.text: Nike releases 5,000 pairs of a sneaker. Resale price hits $800 within hours. The shoe cost $30 to manufacture.

buildup.text: Limited editions combine scarcity and exclusivity. Owning what others can't signals status and creates in-group.

discovery.text: Scarcity plus social identity creates extreme demand. The rarity is the product, not the shoe, watch, or handbag.

twist.text: Some brands destroy unsold inventory to maintain scarcity. Burberry burned $37 million of clothing to protect brand.

climax.text: When chasing a limited release, calculate the true cost: money, time, and stress.

punchline.text: You pay for the limit, not the product.

quiz.question: Why did Burberry destroy $37 million of unsold clothing?
options: To maintain brand scarcity and exclusivity
Tax regulations required disposal of unsold goods
